items.title: EU calls emergency meeting to discuss Ceuta migrant crossings
items.description: There have been tense exchanges between Spain and other EU states over the influx of migrants into the enclave of Ceuta.

items.title: Call for 'full review' as pressure grows on Infantino
items.description: The leadership of Fifa is publicly questioned by football's governing bodies in Europe, North and Central America and the Caribbean.

items.title: Tourist plane crashes in Peru, killing 13
items.description: The small plane was flying over the Nazca Lines ​archaeological site when it crashed, according to local reports.

items.title: Israeli West Bank settler tells BBC attacks on Palestinians are justified as revenge
items.description: Settler violence against Palestinians is on the rise in the West Bank, as settlements and outposts expand.

items.title: Italy putting nearly all major cities on highest heat alert
items.description: Some 19 major Italian cities - including Rome, Milan and Naples - are already on red alert, and by Monday all but two will be.

items.title: Mountaineer Nirmal Purja killed in Pakistan avalanche, his company says
items.description: The renowned mountaineer was known for scaling the world's 14 highest peaks in just over six months in 2019.

items.title: Current Ebola outbreak worst ever in DR Congo, WHO says
items.description: The current strain has so far killed 1,587 people, and there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment.

items.title: Three killed after bomb detonated at Moscow restaurant, state media say
items.description: Security officials said a woman tried to enter the restaurant with explosives but was stopped by a security guard.

items.title: Nine killed in strikes on Kyiv, as Ukraine sinks Russian container ship
items.description: The attack comes as Moscow escalates deadly ballistic missile attacks on the Ukrainian capital.

items.title: Peru's ex-president leaves jail after 15-year jail term for corruption overturned
items.description: Ollanta Humala had been convicted of money laundering offences alongside his wife in 2025.

items.title: India's 'cockroach' protesters have wounds consistent with pellet-gun fire, say experts
items.description: Ballistic experts say the dozens of tiny round punctures are tell-tale signs of pellet gun injuries.

items.title: Trump administration drops Reflecting Pool vandalism charge and admits 'botched' repairs
items.description: President Donald Trump had blamed "sick" vandals, and a former Olympian had been charged, but prosecutors now say contractors caused the damage.
